name: whatsscale
label: WhatsScale
description: Send WhatsApp messages, manage contacts, and automate conversations via WAHA

token.label: API Key
token.description:
To obtain your API key:

    1. Log in to your WhatsScale account at https://whatsscale.com/dashboard
    2. Navigate to Setting => API Keys section
    3. Create a new API key if you don't have one already
    4. Copy your API key and paste it here

whatsscale_delete_crm_contact.label: Delete a CRM Contact
whatsscale_delete_crm_contact.description: Permanently delete a contact from your WhatsScale CRM

whatsscale_list_crm_contacts.label: List CRM Contacts
whatsscale_list_crm_contacts.description: Retrieve a paginated list of CRM contacts with optional filters

search.label: Search
search.description: Optional. Search contacts by name or phone number.

whatsscale_list_crm_tags.label: List CRM Tags
whatsscale_list_crm_tags.description: List every unique tag currently used across CRM contacts.

whatsscale_leave_selected_group.label: Leave a Group
whatsscale_leave_selected_group.description: Make the connected session leave a WhatsApp group selected from the dropdown.

whatsscale_list_participants_in_group.label: List Group Participants
whatsscale_list_participants_in_group.description: List the members of a WhatsApp group selected from the dropdown, and their roles.

limit.label: Limit
limit.description: Max participants to return. Default 100, max 500.

offset.label: Offset
offset.description: Number of participants to skip. Default 0.

whatsscale_leave_group_by_id.label: Leave a Group (By ID)
whatsscale_leave_group_by_id.description: Make the connected session leave a WhatsApp group by group ID.

groupId.label: Group ID
groupId.description: The group ID, with or without the @g.us suffix.

whatsscale_list_group_participants_by_id.label: List Group Participants (By ID)
whatsscale_list_group_participants_by_id.description: List the members of a WhatsApp group and their roles, by group ID.

groupId.label: Group ID
groupId.description: The group ID, with or without the @g.us suffix.

limit.label: Limit
limit.description: Max participants to return. Default 100, max 500.

offset.label: Offset
offset.description: Number of participants to skip. Default 0.

whatsscale_post_text_status.label: Post a Text Status
whatsscale_post_text_status.description: Post a text-only WhatsApp Status (story) with an optional background color.

backgroundColor.label: Background Color
backgroundColor.description: Leave empty for the default WhatsApp green.

whatsscale_check_whatsapp.label: Check WhatsApp Number
whatsscale_check_whatsapp.description: Check if a phone number has WhatsApp

phone.label: Phone Number
phone.description: Phone number with country code (e.g. +31612345678 or 31612345678). Any format accepted.

whatsscale_list_sessions.label: List WhatsApp Sessions
whatsscale_list_sessions.description: List every WhatsApp session (device) connected to this account, and its status.

whatsscale_list_whatsapp_contacts.label: List WhatsApp Contacts
whatsscale_list_whatsapp_contacts.description: List the raw WhatsApp contacts synced to a session. Not the same as the WhatsScale CRM contacts.

limit.label: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of contacts to return. Leave empty for the whole address book, which can run to thousands of entries.

whatsscale_list_whatsapp_groups.label: List WhatsApp Groups
whatsscale_list_whatsapp_groups.description: List the WhatsApp groups a session belongs to.

whatsscale_delete_crm_contact_by_id.label: Delete a CRM Contact (By ID)
whatsscale_delete_crm_contact_by_id.description: Permanently delete a CRM contact by ID, entered directly rather than picked from a list.

contactId.label: Contact ID
contactId.description: The WhatsScale CRM contact ID (from List CRM Contacts or Find a CRM Contact by Phone).
